rationale: The description states digital payments, marketing technology, and merchant acquisition/monetization outcomes, but does not specify the software operations or how these outcomes are delivered.
evidence_spans: Bango brings together digital payments and marketing technology so that you can more effectively market, merchandize and monetize your products to online customers everywhere.
conflict_response: This supports a conventional payments/marketing-technology description but does not identify a specific processor, targeting mechanism, or even clearly distinguish software from services. I avoid importing those assumptions and mark the negative weak/forced.
